messages:
PagerDuty: :rotating_light: Triggered: PROD - Model catalog routing anomaly (PD-84721)
IncidentBot: PagerDuty incident opened: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-84721 — page sent to eng-oncall. Summary: sudden surge of 5xxs on /v1/generate, tokenizer mismatch errors in logs, autotagged 'model-catalog'
Alex K: acking the PD page, I'm on it — pulling logs and checking catalog promotions
IncidentBot: Alex K acknowledged the incident
Priya S: seeing a spike in 500 responses and this in the runtime logs: `TokenizationError: unknown token id 50213 for vocab v2` — looks like requests routed to an older tokenizer variant
Devin M: can you dump the active route mapping? `curl -s https://catalog.internal/routes | jq '.routes[] | select(.model=="redwood-v2")'`
Alex K: route shows `redwood-v2 -> variant: redwood-v2-2026-03-09` but the catalog metadata for that variant lists `tokenizer: v1` while the deployed runtime expects `v2`. wtf. probable bad promotion from staging
Maria L: confirmed — recent promotion pipeline allowed `variant=redwood-v2-2026-03-09` to go live; promotion job's metadata had wrong tokenizer tag. Customer impact: increased 500s for ~2k requests/min for the last 7 minutes, top affected customers: org-121, org-330 (partial failures)
Oncall SRE: good catch. Short term mitigation: pin route to fallback stable variant `redwood-v2-2026-02-15` and disable autopromote for the pipeline. Who can pin now?
Alex K: pinning now — running:

curl -X POST https://catalog.internal/route/pin -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","variant":"redwood-v2-2026-02-15"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN'

Alex K: pinned. response: `{ "status": "ok", "route": "redwood-v2 -> redwood-v2-2026-02-15" }` :thumbsup:
Priya S: routing change propagated to edge in ~20s, error rate dropping — monitoring now.
Devin M: also pushed a temporary rule to reject requests with tokenizer header mismatch at the edge to avoid downstream crashes: `if request.headers['x-tokenizer'] != deployed_tokenizer: return 400` (temporary)
Maria L: I'll open a rollout rollback PR to fix the promotion pipeline metadata and add a check in the promotion job to validate tokenizer compatibility before promoting.
IncidentBot: Escalation check: incident has been acknowledged and mitigated; notifying SRE lead for postmortem: @Maria L @Devin M
Alex K: Customer impact note for ops: ~14k requests failed over 7m window, retry logic re-routed some to fallback causing slight latency blips. No data exfil. Raising SEV-2.
Priya S: collecting examples for eval -- saving request ids and payloads to /var/tmp/catalog-incident/PD-84721/ for repro.
Devin M: rolling an emergency patch to promotion job to validate `tokenizer` field vs runtime supported set. Patch draft: `scripts/promo_validate_tokenizer.py` — will merge after quick review
Maria L: starting incident page in status page: writeup and initial timeline, will include mitigation steps and next steps (rollback, pipeline fix, improved checks, automation to auto-pin on mismatch).
Alex K: handing off to night oncall @Devin M in 30 minutes — I'll stay for 10 to confirm stable. After that please run through the postmortem checklist: create timeline, impact, root cause (bad promotion metadata), mitigations, and owner for follow-ups.
Devin M: acked. noted follow-ups: 1) block autopromote until metadata validation exists, 2) improve alerting to detect tokenizer mismatches earlier, 3) add unit test in promotion pipeline.
IncidentBot: Incident status changed to 'mitigated' by Alex K — please update on-call notes and assign postmortem owner.
Alex K: final check: error rate back to baseline, no more tokenization errors in 4 consecutive 1m windows. Marking as mitigated, will file postmortem tomorrow. :wave:
Devin M: thanks — I'll draft the postmortem and ping infra to enforce a promotion validation gate.
Maria L: assigning postmortem owner to Devin M in JIRA: RDW-INC-2026-84721.
PagerDuty: Incident PD-84721 closed (auto-close after mitigation window).
